main_body: Round war drum hanging on a wooden frame: a tan drumhead ellipse on top (rows ~3-11) over an orange-red cylindrical body (rows ~12-22) with a yellow stud trim and a dark base rim
top_band: tan/cream drumhead ellipse with a lighter highlight patch, rows 3-11, with a studded rim around it
evidence: The center column shows a tan drumhead ellipse about 8 rows tall (rows 3-11), a yellow stud and dark red line at rows 12-13 marking the front edge with shading beneath it, then an orange cylindrical body about 10 rows tall (rows 12-22) with a gold stud row and a dark base at rows 21-23. The top reads as a clear elliptical surface, as in the guide's green column and barrel. The wooden frame posts are small details. The drum is a proper 3/4 object.

style.evidence: The drum has about 5 steps on the orange body (light peach left, orange, mid, dark red-brown right) and 3-4 on the drumhead (cream highlight, tan, ochre, brown). Outlines are dark red-brown or brown tinted to the adjacent material rather than black. The yellow studs and highlight patch add some texture. The wooden frame is fairly flat with only 2-3 browns, and the lower-left area has little grain. The drum body is smooth gradient-banded without much dotting, so it is slightly less rich than the stall and well references, but it would sit acceptably next to them.
